title: Story premise ENT070: The Arrow That Was a Fish
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: The directions have a tail. Takeaway/theme: Check whether an apparent instruction is actually a sign.
description: A traveler follows a painted arrow through a gallery, but it repeatedly appears to point back toward the entrance. Walking around the freestanding sculpture reveals that the supposed arrow is a flat fish silhouette viewed end-on; a separate clearly labeled route sign finally leads to the exhibit.
